reviews.title: Great memory !!!
reviews.comment: Great memory !!! Worth every penny. I used them for more than 1 year with 13th gen Intel Core i7 13700K, a motherboard Asus TUF gaming Z790 plus, GPU zotac NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 and 2TB SSD Samsung 980 PRO with heatsink. Case, power supply and fans Corsair. Pretty good system for a medium budget. No issues so far.
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.title: I run these at 6.4GHz on an MSI Z790 motherboard with no issues
reviews.comment: I just built a water cooled PC to run a high end flight simulator. I started out with 32GB but wanted to complete the DDR5 look since I already spend over three grand, so I increased the RAM to 64GB. Initially it was running at the default speed. The MSI MEG Z790 ACE motherboard offered standard options for 6.2 and 6.4 GHz so I selected 6.2 at first. That ran fine, so I selected 6.4. The increase of 3.2% in clock speed gave me an increase of 2.5% in CPU mark. The average score for the i7-14700K is 53462, with this motherboard and memory I am getting 57729. I have run a variety of benchmarks and stress tests and had zero issues. This combination of motherboard, processor, and DDR5 is solid. My only complaint is that this setup doesn't support the  same color schemes for the DDR5  as for the GPU, motherboard, and fans. I don't know whether that is an inconsistency of the motherboard, or some limitation of these memory parts.
